svg.title: Coastline 2D: barrier island with mixed energy

desc.ian_image_library:title: Coastline 2D: barrier island with mixed energy

ian_image_library:descr.p: Illustration of a barrier island coast with mixed (wave & tide) energy. The morphology shows an ebb-tidal delta, a drumstick barrier island, tidal inlets, tidal creeks, and saltmarsh.
